title: Skeletron core fight: separately killable hands that slap and swipe, spin defense, Expert skull volleys, lethal day rage
player_outcome: Skeletron now fights as in Terraria. Its two hands (600 life each) can be destroyed separately and take turns: a slap dropping from above, and a sideways swipe. The skull spins every few seconds at lowered defense. In Expert, each living hand armours the skull (+25 defense), and once a hand falls or the skull is below 75% it fires homing skulls. By day it is lethal and all but invulnerable.
design: New brain 'skeletronHand': new src/Strata.Core/AI/HandBrain.cs, params in new src/Strata.Core/Content/Specs/BossBrainSpecs.cs, registered in BrainSpecs.Register and BrainFactory.

HandParams: Style ('alternate'|'slap'|'swipe'; P4-28 and P4-31 add punch/saw/vice/hold), AttackInterval 300, WindupTicks 40, StrikeTicks 45, StrikeSpeed 16 m/s, ReturnSpeed 10, ExpertSpeed 1.25, ExpertInterval 0.7.

Hand state is Phase 0 rest, 1 windup, 2 strike, 3 recover. Rest follows Anchor (set by FollowLeader from the head's rotated offset) with a small bob. The side is sign(LeaderOffset.X); the right hand's first attack is delayed by half an interval so the hands alternate.
Slap: wind up to target + (0, 4 m, 0) + side×1.5 m, then strike down through the captured target position.
Swipe: wind up to target + side×5 m + (0, 1 m, 0), then sweep horizontally through the target at 1.1× StrikeSpeed.
Hands are MovesFreely with no gravity (they pass through walls like Terraria's). Contact damage in all phases. They mirror the head's DamageScale and DefenseOverride (day rage).

CryptWardenBrain: move it to its own file src/Strata.Core/AI/CryptWardenBrain.cs, out of DungeonBrains.cs. HandsAlive = living IsPart followers when the boss has Parts; the legacy Segments path stays for Skeletron Prime until P4-28.
Spin cadence as Terraria: SpinInterval 800 and SpinDuration 400 ticks. While spinning, npc.DefenseDelta += SpinDefense (−10) and ctx.Cue(npc, 'boss_roar') plays at the start.
Expert, while hovering: DefenseDelta += ExpertDefensePerHand (25) × HandsAlive.
Expert skulls: when HandsAlive < 2 or life < 75%, every SkullInterval (80, or 40 with no hands) fire ctx.Shoot(Skull, from the head, toward the target × SkullSpeed, SkullDamage) if ctx.InSight.
When Frenzied (the day enrage from P4-01) it spins continuously at SpinSpeed × SpeedScale. Speeds use npc.SpeedScale; the old DayEnrage branch is removed.
game/Entities/NpcRenderer.Arms.cs: draw arms from the head to each living IsPart follower when Boss.Parts is non-empty, keeping the segment path for Prime.
game/Entities/NpcRenderer.cs: when npc.Mirrored, scale the basis X by −1 after Orient.
Validator: CryptWarden needs ≥ 2 segments or ≥ 2 parts. skeletronHand enemies must be listed as some boss's part (warn otherwise).
Move the warden test out of tests/Strata.Core.Tests/Gameplay/DungeonTests.cs into SkeletonTests.cs, rewritten for parts.
